Linux Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Linux Developer for a contract opportunity in Chandler, AZ.
 

 Linux Developer Job Details 
 

 This person will be responsible for the build of automated distribution for client products.  
 

 Linux Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 - Recent experience performing installation, configuration and deployment of Linux OS (any distro) and applications.
 - Experience writing Bash scripts on Linux. 
 - Experience with installation, configuration or administration of MySQL or a similar RDBMS. 
 - Experience with a Source Version Control System (Subversion, Git or Perforce preferred). 
 - Great problem solving/troubleshooting skills. 
 - (optional) Experience with Amazon Web Services. 
 - (optional) Experience writing installers for any type of software. 
 - (optional) C++/STL/WinAPI-Win32
 
 
 Linux Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 Linux Developer Assignment Length 
 

 6 months with possible extensions
 

  


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
